apis.name: AmadeusCarsQuickConnect_v1
apis.description: Amadeus Cars Quick Connect is a set of car reservation APIs based on REST protocol designed for Travel Sellers with online presence to shop, book, retrieve and cancel car rental offers from providers globally.

data.name: Payout B2B Wallet
data.shortDescription: B2B Wallet is a solution for travel sellers needed a way to pay their travel providers. This portfolio may showcase SOAP webservices.

services.name: PAY_CancelVirtualCardLoad
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: To cancel a previously scheduled load to a virtual card.

services.name: PAY_DeleteVirtualCard
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: The DeleteVirtualCard messages enable the travel agency to delete a virtual card previously generated with the GenerateVirtualCard message.

services.name: PAY_GenerateVirtualCard
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue:
This API will act as the gateway to generate any type of virtual card offered by Amadeus. Virtual Cards will allow travel agencies to pay their suppliers, typically with a single use unique card number.<br>
Additionally, extended data regarding the travel taking place is also requested to improve the travel agency or corporation's reconciliation process.

services.name: PAY_GetVirtualCardDetails
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: The aim of the API is to get detailed information of a specific virtual card.

services.name: PAY_ListVirtualCards
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: The aim of the API is to search and retrieve a list of virtual cards.

services.name: PAY_ScheduleVirtualCardLoad
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: Schedules a load transfer to a virtual card

services.name: PAY_UpdateVirtualCard
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: This API allows certain elements of a virtual card that has been already created to be modified. This includes items such as the card limitations, the associated additional data and the status of the card

apis.name: PaymentB2BWallet_v1
apis.description: The B2B Wallet API allows the creation, list, update, delete of virtual payment cards. It also allows to perform operations related to them, such as scheduling fund transfers, and the sending of notifications.

apis.name: PaymentB2BWalletFundingAccount_v2
apis.description: The B2B Wallet Funding Account API is used for retrieving the details and real-time balance of a funding account

services.name: FOP_CreateFormOfPayment
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue:
Adds an "FP" element in a PNR or in a pricing record, optionally performing a card authorization as well.

Data related to payment is stored in the FP element of the PNR, and is treated by Amadeus according to PCI-DSS compliancy standards.

services.name: PNR_AddFrequentFlyer
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: Add a reference to a Frequent Traveller Card in a PNR

services.name: PNR_AddMultiElements
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: This API allows a user to make an entire reservation in the Amadeus system with one transaction. This is an efficient way to create a reservation and reduces the number of transactions required from the client application.

services.name: PNR_AddSSR
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: This web services is used to create a Special Service Request (SSR).

services.name: PNR_Cancel
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: This API is used to cancel single or multiple elements from a Passenger Name Record (PNR). The cancelled elements are moved to PNR history. Flown or past date auxiliary segments cannot be cancelled from the PNR.

services.name: PNR_ChangeElement
PNR_Commit
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: Provides the possibility to commit modifications made to the PNR and release it

services.name: PNR_CreateTSM
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: To be able to create the TSM for an EMD used for booking ancillary services

services.name: PNR_DisplayTSM
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: This API allows to display a TSM from a PNR in a stateless mode.

services.name: PNR_Ignore
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: Ignore all modifications made to the current PNR and release it

services.name: PNR_NameChange
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: Provides the possibility to update a passenger name or change a passenger name

services.name: PNR_Redisplay
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: This API is used to redisplay the active Passenger Name Record (PNR).

services.name: PNR_RequestTimeLimits
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: This API computes Time Limits (such as Ticketing Time Limits) from a PNR context, for all airlines, present in the itinerary, which have subscribed to the Amadeus Time Limits product.

services.name: PNR_Retrieve
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: This API is used to retrieve and display an active PNR or to redisplay a PNR during the current session.

services.name: PNR_RetrieveAndDisplay
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: This API is used to retrieve and display an active Passenger Name Record (PNR).

services.name: PNR_RetrieveByOARloc
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: Retrieve PNRs by record locator that the customer has as a reference from the PNR's booking

services.name: PNR_RetrieveByRecLoc
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: The API allows the user to retrieve a PNR by its Record Locator.

services.name: PNR_Split
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: This API separates passengers from a parent Passenger Name Record and creates a new child PNR with these passengers and their associated segments and elements. The parent and child PNRs are then linked through Associated Record Indexing (AXR).

services.name: PNR_TransferOwnership
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: This API is used to change the owner office ID of a given Passenger Name Record. The office can be either an Amadeus office ID or a third party. Additionally, queuing Office ID, ticketing Office ID and Option Office ID can be modified.

services.name: PNR_DisplayHistory
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue:
This API is used to retrieve the history of a Passenger Name Record (PNR).<br>
The PNR History contains the information about the creation, modification and cancellation of the different PNR elements plus all the actions that involves the PNR such as queuing.

services.name: PNR_Replicate
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: This API copies elements from an existing Passenger Name record (PNR), referred to as the source PNR, and starts the creation of a new PNR, referred as the replicated PNR.

services.name: PNR_Search
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue:
This API provides a way to search for Passenger Name Records (PNR) via different search criteria such as flight data. The result will be a list of PNRs.<br>
This API does not allow the retrieval of a PNR by a PNR Record Locator.

apis.name: FlightCreateOrders_v1
apis.description: The Flight Create Orders API allows you to book flights and ancillaries like bags or seats.

apis.name: FlightOrderManagement_v1
apis.description: The Flight Order Management is an API allowing you to do several operations on your existing booking. With the Get operation, you'll be able to retrieve information stored in the booking record. The Delete operation will allow you to cancel a booking if tickets have not been issued already. The PATCH operation will allow you to book seats on your existing flight booking.

services.name: MiniRule_GetFromETicket
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue:
This web service will not profit of latest Mini Rules enhancements.
Please use MiniRule_GetFromRec (TMRXRQ) instead.

Mini Rules provides a short and easy to read summary of the most important rules and restrictions  in a structured output so that they can be clearly understood by end-users and customers. This API is used to retrieve the Mini Rules data from an electronic ticket, with the E-Ticket number.

services.name: MiniRule_GetFromPricing
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue:
This web service will not profit of latest Mini Rules enhancements.
Please use MiniRule_GetFromRec (TMRXRQ) instead.
Mini Rules provides a short and easy to read summary of the most important rules and restrictions in a structured output so that they can be clearly understood by end-users and customers. This API can be used following any of the following transactions:\
- PNR pricing
- Best pricing
- Ticket Changer
- Standalone pricing

services.name: MiniRule_GetFromPricingRec
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue:
This web service will not profit of latest Mini Rules enhancements.
Please use MiniRule_GetFromRec (TMRXRQ) instead.
Mini Rules provides a short and easy to read summary of the most important rules and restrictions in a structured output so that they can be clearly understood by end-users and customers. This API is used to retrieve the Mini Rules data from a TST (Transitional Stored Ticket) or a PQR (Quotation Record for Amadeus Offer).

services.name: Fare_PricePNRWithLowestFare
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue:
This API allows a user to get the best price for the itinerary present in a Passenger Name Record (PNR). The best pricing can be done for the whole PNR or for a selection of passengers and/or flight segments. 
No check is done on the availability.

services.name: Fare_CheckRules

services.name: Hotel_MultiSingleAvailability

services.name: Hotel_EnhancedPricing
services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: This API provides full details for a specific product, which was returned in a previously performed Enhanced Single Availability request.

apis.name: HotelSearch_v3
apis.description: The Hotel Search REST/JSON API is a hotel search API that enables you to find the best hotel offers that match your search from a wide choice of providers. The results contain the hotel details and will allow the user to select their preferred option based on either price, location or amenities. A wide range of search criteria can be applied to narrow the search results.

apis.name: HotelList_v1
apis.description:
The Hotel list REST JSON API help you find the list of hotels inside a city or an area.  The API returns the name, address, geoCode, and time zone for each hotel bookable in Amadeus. You can use the unique Hotel Id of each hotel to get the list of available hotel-offers and book a room.

This API answer the question: "What are the hotel close to the conference center?"

apis.name: HotelBookingManage_v2
apis.description:
This service allows a client to update a hotel booking inside a hotel order.

Following attributes of a hotel booking can be updated using this service:

Customer ID (for hotel loyalty programs)
Special Requests (Supplementary Information)
A request should contain at-least one attribute to be modified (from the list above)

If the update is successful, a confirmation with the complete Hotel Order is returned.

apis.name: HotelBooking_v2
HotelBookingRetrievebyReference_v2
apis.description:
This service allows the user to retrieve a Hotel Order using a reference PNR record locator value. 

The required inputs are:
  1. reference. Used to pass the PNR record locator value (example: ABCDEF) 
  2. originSystemCode. Used to pass the code of the Origin system generating the reference. As the reference is a PNR record locator, the originSystemCode is set to GDS 

If the retrieve is successful, the complete Hotel Order is returned.

apis.name: HotelBookingRetrieve_v2
apis.description:
This service allows the user to retrieve a Hotel Order. 

The required input is the Hotel Order ID.

If the retrieve is successful, the complete Hotel Order is returned.

apis.name: Etraveli-OrderCreationEvents_v1
apis.description: The Etraveli - Order Creation Events behaves as Event Handler, when events are notified by a broker from Etraveli Group. At each event notified to Amadeus, the API feeds a database where the stored information will be used for later offline internal processing.

services.name: Fare_SellByFareCalendar

services.name: PriceXplorer_ExtremeSearch

services.shortDescriptionInCatalogue: The Master Pricer Product is an interactive Low Fare Search Product designed to enable a customer to navigate through a large volume of recommendation by sorting and filtering.

apis.name: FlightOffersSearch_v2
apis.description: The Flight Offers Search API allows to get cheapest flight recommendations and prices on a given journey. It provides a list of flight recommendations and fares from a given origin (city or airport), for a given date (or date range) and for a given list of passengers. Additional information such as bag allowance, first ancillary bag prices or fare details are also provided

apis.name: FlightOffersPrice_v1
apis.description: Flight Offers Price allows to validate a fare provided by Flight Offers Search. It also provides ancillaries information and payment information details.

apis.name: BrandedFaresUpsell_v1
apis.description:
The **BrandedFaresUpsell** REST/JSON service enables you to get upgraded Branded Fares flight recommendations available from a flight offer.

Branded Fares are airline offers in which airline bundles its airfares with options and features, such as refundability and miles accrual, or a pre-reserved seat, baggage, and meal.

It is usually used after the Flight Offers Search service.

apis.name: FlightAvailabilitiesSearch_v1
apis.description: The Amadeus Flight Availability API provides a list of flights with seats for sale on a given itinerary and the quantity of seats available in different fare classes. In addition to availability, the API also returns carrier and aircraft information, the departure and arrival terminals, schedule, and route.

apis.name: NDCSeatmapDisplay_v1
apis.description:
The NDC Seatmap Display API provides airplane cabin information for an given flight offered via NDC connectivity. The API returns pricing and availability for seats and details on in-flight amenities like food and beverage service, entertainment options or wi-fi.

This API answers the question, "What are my seating options on this flight?"

apis.name: SeatMapDisplay_v1
apis.description: "Seatmap Display" API allows you to get information to display airplane cabin plan from a Flight Offer in order for the traveler to be able to choose his seat during the flight booking flow.

services.name: Hotel_DescriptiveInfo

apis.name: HotelContentDetails_v3
apis.description:
The Hotel Content API provides functionality for retrieving static and descriptive content of an Individual Property. 
    The following are the main characteristics of this new API:
    - Provides basic Information of Hotel properties including Hotel Address and Contact.
    - Provides content related to Hotel facilities which includes Meeting Rooms, Restaurant and Hotel Facilities
    - Awards and Promotion related content.
    - Hotel Policies which includes Pets Policies, CheckIn and CheckOut policies
    - Multimedia Description depicting Textual and Image content 
    - Hotel Rooms and Point of Interest which includes attraction places near Hotel property.
